protocol.copyright: Copyright 2026 BifrOSt. Private protocol of the BifrOSt window server (docs/window-server.md, "Materials").

interface.name: bifrost_material_manager_v1
interface.description: Extends ext-background-effect-v1 with a material kind per region. A region without a kind keeps the plain blur of ext-background-effect-v1. The window server owns the recipe (blur, saturation, tint, active state).

request.name: get_material

description.summary: make a material object for a surface

request.description: A surface has at most one material object; asking again is a protocol error.

interface.name: bifrost_material_surface_v1
interface.description: All requests are double-buffered and applied on the surface's next wl_surface.commit. Regions are in surface coordinates. When a surface has any material region, its ext-background-effect-v1 blur region is ignored.

description.summary: remove all materials from the next commit on

entry.name: follows_window
entry.summary: active when the window is, else the inactive fallback

entry.name: behind_window
entry.summary: everything composited below the window, wallpaper included

entry.name: within_window
entry.summary: only the surface's own content below the region

request.name: add_region
request.description: The region is resolved like ext-background-effect-v1 (added minus subtracted rectangles). Corner radii are in surface-local logical pixels and round the outline of the region's bounding box.

arg.name: emphasized
arg.summary: 0 or 1: the selected or emphasised variant of the material
